title: Part-time medical transcribing to leave time to practice
summary: She did part-time jobs such as medical transcribing, translating and editing so she could practice.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: I’ve heard that sentiment stated in a similar fashion before, that if you’re going to go into the music world, and especially jazz, you better have to do it. If it’s just a passing fancy then —

It wouldn’t work, no. And I was willing to do a series of part time jobs. We were talking about transcribing, and I did many years as a medical transcriber. Anything that — I tried full time work but I just wasn’t able to get any practicing in. So I went to part time jobs that didn’t take a whole lot of concentration. I like transcribing. I’m good at it. Because I’m good with language and different other kinds of jobs like that you know, and odds and ends of translating as well and editing and stuff.
